name: Seeking the face of God
promise: One teaching: learn what it means to seek God's face, how to do it, and how to know you have met him.
why: For any believer, including someone new to faith. In one complete teaching he shows why we seek God (we were made to need him), what seeking his face means in real decisions, how to keep the mind engaged in prayer, and the sign that you have met him: anxiety lifts and you are at rest.

days.theme: Meet God personally and leave at rest
days.key_quote: If you have had this experience before, it takes away anxiety, it takes away fear, it takes away worry, and he brings ventilation and you are at rest inside.
